name: Serra's Realm
description: The realm where Serra healed Urza.

description_citations.text: "Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian black mana corrupts Serra's Realm, drives away Serra, and leads to Radiant's coup; Urza evacuates some angels to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza was able to evacuate some of the angels to Dominaria

citation.text: "Angel", section "Serra angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's head proposes recreating Serra's Realm, but Karn tells of the Null Moon, and the Weatherlight planeshifts there to gather white mana.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight planeshifts to that moon and gathers the mana within

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Urza's invasion of Serra's Realm, Barrin battles the Phyrexian overlord.
timeline.quote: Barrin battled the Phyrexian overlord in charge of the Serran government's displacement

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Battle of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pursued by Phyrexian negators, Urza and Xantcha flee across planes and land in Serra's Realm, where Serra helps Urza recover.
timeline.quote: There Urza recovers with the help of the plane's white planeswalker creator Serra.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra creates Serra's Realm.
timeline.quote: She created her heavenly plane

citation.text: "Serra", section "Creation of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians track Urza to the realm, taint it, and Serra abandons it, entrusting Radiant.
timeline.quote: entrusting the archangel Radiant as its caretaker in her absence

citation.text: "Serra", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant's corrupted angels slaughter the Realm's inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Radiant's corrupted angels becoming a terrible winged army

citation.text: "Serra", section "Radiant and the end of the Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza saves refugees and collapses the plane into the Weatherlight's powerstone.
timeline.quote: saved many Serran refugees before collapsing the plane

citation.text: "Serra", section "Radiant and the end of the Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra creates the artificial plane Serra's Realm, where she and her followers live in peace defended by angels.
timeline.quote: She created an artificial plane known as Serra's Realm, where she and her followers lived in peace defended by flights of angels.

citation.text: "Serra". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra creates the Realm hoping to build a haven where suffering could be avoided forever.
timeline.quote: Serra made the Realm in the hopes that she could make a haven where suffering could be avoided forever.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Urza leaves, the Phyrexians attack; repelled, their black mana taints the Realm and Serra proposes an exodus and flees.
timeline.quote: their black mana forever tainted the realm, causing Serra to propose a massive exodus to the realm inhabitants and flee.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant takes control and, trying to expunge Phyrexian influence, becomes their unwitting tool and exterminates loyal Serrans.
timeline.quote: Radiant became an unwitting tool of the Phyrexians and began exterminating loyal Serrans.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza returns with the Weatherlight, rescues thousands of refugees and collapses the plane into the ship's powerstone core.
timeline.quote: rescuing thousands of Serran refugees before finally collapsing the plane into the ship's powerstone core

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4308 AR Karona, Sash and Waistcoat visit a recreated Realm where an angel calling herself Serra says she has been rebuilding it since the powerstone exploded.
timeline.quote: Serra had been working to rebuild the realm since then.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Recreation of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza visits Serra's Realm and meets Radiant, who reprimands him, lets him watch her purification armies, then refuses to let him take refugees and declares him a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: Radiant refuses and declares him a Phyrexian

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza evacuates refugees and learns Radiant's soul torches are siphoning the plane's white mana through her sleeper Gorig.
timeline.quote: Urza repeatedly returns to Serra's Realm to evacuate hundreds of refugees to Dominaria

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Serra's Realm Barrin tricks Gorig into impaling itself on the Weatherlight, charging the powerstone, while Radiant kills Gherridarigaaz and rips out Urza's powerstone eyes.
timeline.quote: Radiant challenges Urza to single combat and kills Gherridarigaaz.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant tries to rejoin the powerstones, causing an explosion that destroys her and reconstitutes Urza; the crew escapes as Serra's Realm collapses.
timeline.quote: causing an explosion that destroys her and reconstitutes Urza

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza flees from plane to plane, visits Zendikar and is healed by Serra, after which the Phyrexians corrupt her realm.
timeline.quote: Urza came to Serra's Realm and was healed by Serra

citation.text: "Urza", section "Exploring the Origins of Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza builds the Weatherlight and sacrifices the energies of Serra's Realm to power it.
timeline.quote: Urza decided to use the energies of the collapsing Phyrexian-overrun plane of Serra's Realm

citation.text: "Urza", section "Building the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The set's story follows Urza as he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him.
timeline.quote: he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him

citation.text: "Urza's Saga", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza collapses Serra's Realm's worldsoul into the Weatherlight's powerstone core, giving it the power to travel the planes.
timeline.quote: giving it enough power to travel the planes

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra heals Urza at Serra's Realm; Phyrexians track them down and they escape to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza and Xantcha planeswalked to Dominaria, escaping the destruction.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the plane's white planeswalker creator Serra

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
